description: This bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two text-to-SQL generation models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four categories in order from left to right. For each category, there are two grouped bars: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL, as indicated by the legend. The specific values are labeled atop each bar: for the Simple category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21 and TA-SQL has 63.14; for Moderate, NatSQL has 48.60 and TA-SQL has 48.60; for Challenging, NatSQL has 32.32 and TA-SQL has 36.11; and for Total, NatSQL has 51.35 and TA-SQL has 56.19. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and numerical labeling.
